def get_divisors(number):
    divisors_list = set()
    divisor_candidate = 1
    while divisor_candidate * divisor_candidate <= number:
        if number % divisor_candidate == 0:
            divisors_list.add(divisor_candidate)
            divisors_list.add(number // divisor_candidate)
        divisor_candidate += 1
    return sorted(divisors_list)
